definition: Part of the circumference of a circle; with radius $r$ and angle $\theta$ degrees at the centre, its length is $\frac{\theta}{360} \times 2\pi r$.
The region of a circle between two radii and the arc joining their ends; with radius $r$ and angle $\theta$ degrees at the centre, its area is $\frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^{2}$.
